name.baseName: Disposal, emulsion paint, 0% water, to municipal incineration

dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: This dataset represents the activity of waste disposal of waste emulsion paint in a municipal solid waste incinerator (MSWI) Recommended use of this dataset: For small amounts of dried waste emulsion paint, which go to disposal as part of communal waste mixture, e.g. small leftovers or paint on other material. Larger amounts of waste paint, unused liquid paint or removed (stripped) paint are to be disposed in hazardous waste incinerator. Waste composition (wet, in ppm): upper heating value 11.14 MJ/kg; lower heating value 10.51 MJ/kg; H2O n.a.; O 214760; H 31708; C 268330; S n.a.; N n.a.; P n.a.; B n.a.; Cl 86465; Br n.a.; F n.a.; I n.a.; Ag n.a.; As 0.44122; Ba n.a.; Cd 0.016849; Co n.a.; Cr 1.248; Cu n.a.; Hg 0.0085442; Mn n.a.; Mo n.a.; Ni 0.95527; Pb 0.64946; Sb n.a.; Se n.a.; Sn n.a.; V n.a.; Zn 6.5444; Be n.a.; Sc n.a.; Sr n.a.; Ti 135000; Tl n.a.; W n.a.; Si 149810; Fe n.a.; Ca 113920; Al n.a.; K n.a.; Mg n.a.; Na n.a.; Share of carbon in waste that is biogenic 0%. Share of metals in waste not oxidised and bulk-recyclable (exclude very small or thin parts) Iron: 0%; Alu: 0%; Copper: 0%. One kg of this waste produces 0.7064 kg of slag and 0.1612 kg of residues, which are landfilled. Additional solidification with 0.06448 kg of cement. Net energy production: 1.14MJ/kg electric energy and 2.51MJ/kg thermal energy. Recovery of metal scrap to recycling: 0g iron scrap, 0g aluminium scrap, 0g copper scrap.;; UUID: d55bdfd9-e60c-4ea3-82a9-2e9c2549f46d

time.common:timeRepresentativenessDescription: Waste composition as given in literature reference, theoretical data or other source. Transfer coefficients for modern MSWI.

locationOfOperationSupplyOrProduction.descriptionOfRestrictions: Specific to the technology mix encountered in Switzerland in 2010. Well applicable to modern incineration practices in Europe, North America or Japan.

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
average Swiss MSWI plants in 2010 (grate incinerators) with electrostatic precipitator for fly ash (ESP), wet flue gas scrubber and 25% SNCR , 42.77% SCR-high dust , 32.68% SCR-low dust -DeNOx facilities and 0% without Denox (weighted according to mass of burnt waste, representing Swiss average). Efficiency of iron scrap separation from slag : 58%. Efficiency of non-ferrous scrap separation from slag : 31%. Gross electric efficiency technology mix 15.84% and Gross thermal efficiency technology mix 28.51%

# Included processes
Waste incineration from waste reception gate further downstream (excluding transport to the MSWI plant). Waste-specific air and water emisions from incineration, auxiliary material consumption for flue gas cleaning. Short-term emissions to river water and long-term emisisons to ground water from slag compartment (from bottom ash) and residual material landfill (from solidified fly ashes and scrubber slugde). Waste-specific process energy demands for MSWI and net energy generation.
